parts:
Why these two packages cannot be used?
My codes are given below:
#
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    http://shiny.rstudio.com/
#
#install.packages("jiebaR")
#install.packages("wordcloud")
library(shiny)
library(wordcloud)
library(jiebaR)
# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("中国共产党党章词云图"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins 
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("MaxN",
                  "Number of bins:",
                  min = 1,
                  max = 200,
                  value = 30)
    ),
    
    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("distPlot")
    )
  )
)

f="中国共产党章程



第五十三条　中国共产党的党徽党旗是中国共产党的象征和标志。党的各级组织和每一个党员都要维护党徽党旗的尊严。要按照规定制作和使用党徽党旗。"
#f <- scan('中国共产党章程.txt',sep='\n',what='',encoding="UTF-8")
mpseg=jiebaR::worker("mp")
seg <- mpseg[f] #使用qseg类型分词，并把结果保存到对象seg中
seg <- seg[nchar(seg)>1] #去除字符长度小于2的词语

seg <- table(seg) #统计词频

seg <- seg[!grepl('[0-9]+',names(seg))] #去除数字

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    
    
    wordcloud::wordcloud(names(seg), seg, colors = rainbow(100), random.order=F,max.words = input$MaxN)
    
  })
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.subject: Re: Error in value[[3L]](cond) : there do not exit package of ‘wordcloud’ and 'jiabaR'
parts:
Not sure where you are seeing that error, but when I deploy your code to shinyapps.io I see:

Loading required package: RColorBrewer Loading required package: jiebaRD Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "jieba.dict.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath, : cannot open file '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8': Permission denied Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "hmm_model.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath, : cannot open file '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jiebaRD/dict/hmm_model.utf8': Permission denied Error in unzip(file.path(jiebapath, "dict", "idf.zip"), exdir = file.path(jiebapath, : cannot open file '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jiebaRD/dict/idf.utf8': Permission denied 2017-10-23 13:36:51 ../inst/include/lib/DictTrie.hpp:140 FATAL exp: [ifs.is_open()] false. open /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8 failed. terminate called after throwing an instance of 'Rcpp::exception' what(): 2017-10-23 13:36:51 ../inst/include/lib/DictTrie.hpp:140 FATAL exp: [ifs.is_open()] false. open /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/jiebaRD/dict/jieba.dict.utf8 failed.


From what I can tell, jiebaR is attempting to unzip a file from jiebaRD inside the system site-library. Applications running on shinyapps.io are not privileged on the system, which is why we have the shinyapps-package-dependencies mechanism for installing system dependencies.

Options are to open an issue with the package author to unzip on install, or to add an issue or pull request to shinyapps-package-dependencies to unzip the files upon installation, which is earlier and privileged than when the application is running.
